skills.name: sofia-phone-operation
skills.description: Operate installed HarmonyOS apps with the phone-local HDC tools, current UI evidence and safe foreground restoration. Apply when the task requires an external app.

skills.name: sofia-failure-recovery
skills.description: Recover from changed pages, uncertain inputs, system dialogs and phone transport errors with bounded retries and honest partial results.

skills.name: sofia-price-comparison
skills.description: Compare products across requested shopping apps using exact SKU evidence, price conditions and bounded work per platform. Apply only to shopping comparison tasks.

skills.name: sofia-jd
skills.description: Operate the native HarmonyOS JD app for search and read-only shopping research. Apply when the task names JD/京东 or targets com.jd.hm.mall.

skills.name: sofia-taobao
skills.description: Operate the native HarmonyOS Taobao app for search and read-only shopping research. Apply when the task names Taobao/淘宝 or targets com.taobao.taobao4hmos.

skills.name: sofia-pinduoduo
skills.description: Search and read product evidence in the installed HarmonyOS Pinduoduo app. Apply for 拼多多/Pinduoduo or com.xunmeng.pinduoduo.hos.

skills.name: sofia-result-presentation
skills.description: Present any final Sofia result as concise mobile-friendly semantic content. Apply to every final user-facing response, regardless of task domain.
